prospects.thesis: SMCI is a direct beneficiary of hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildout as a leading provider of GPU-optimized servers and liquid-cooled rack solutions for Blackwell-generation deployments. The +44.3% monthly momentum combined with an exceptionally low 0.6x P/S signals the market is re-rating the name post-accounting overhang, while bullish options and institutional flow confirm smart money accumulation. Entry now captures the pre-earnings positioning into the next Blackwell shipment cycle.

MongoDB is the leading document database for AI-native applications, with its Atlas Vector Search product positioning it as critical infrastructure for RAG-based generative AI workloads. The 39% one-month rally alongside bullish options and institutional flow reflects renewed conviction that Atlas consumption is re-accelerating as enterprises operationalize AI pilots. Momentum and theme leadership justify inclusion despite the 13.8x P/S.

Kratos is a pure-play on autonomous defense — unmanned aerial systems (Valkyrie), hypersonics, and tactical drones — all priority Pentagon budget lines under the current CCA and Replicator initiatives. Unlike IT services peers (BAH, CACI, LDOS), KTOS offers hardware-driven exposure to attritable combat systems, providing genuine sub-niche diversification. Bullish institutional positioning and +18.5% momentum suggest continued re-rating as production contracts scale.

CACI provides mission-critical software, SIGINT, and electronic warfare technology to intelligence agencies and DoD — a higher-margin, tech-forward profile than traditional services peers. The 1.5x P/S is attractive relative to the sector's growth trajectory, but bearish institutional signal is a yellow flag warranting patience despite the +28.8% run. Monitor for a healthy pullback before committing capital.

GitLab's Duo AI coding assistant and end-to-end DevSecOps platform position it as a critical AI-productivity layer in enterprise software development, differentiated from database (MDB) and infrastructure (SMCI) plays. The 7.5x P/S is reasonable for a company at this growth rate, and +31.9% momentum with bullish options/institutional confirmation suggests the market is pricing in Duo attach-rate acceleration ahead of the next earnings print.
